target.statement: Anomaly detection rate of 95% with false-positive rate below 5% using the composite ARF framework (Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, Autoencoder, K-Means, DBSCAN) on credit card transaction data.
target.dataset: Proprietary credit-card transaction data from a mid-sized financial institution over 12 months, enriched with external risk indicators and cardholder profiles.

title: Advanced fraud detection using machine learning models: enhancing financial transaction security
